Executive Summary

This report provides a comprehensive analysis of Bitcoin's historical price data from September 17, 2014, to January 28, 2026, spanning over 11 years of trading activity. The analysis reveals Bitcoin's remarkable growth trajectory, extreme volatility characteristics, and evolving market dynamics.

Key Findings:

  • Total Return: 19,400.97% from 457 to 89,185
  • Annualized Return CAGR: 59.04%
  • All-Time High: 126,198 reached in 2025
  • Average Daily Volatility: 4.48%
  • Maximum Single-Day Gain: 25.25%
  • Maximum Single-Day Loss: -37.17%

1. Price Trend Analysis

Long-Term Price Movement

Bitcoin's price history demonstrates exponential growth with multiple boom-bust cycles. The asset has experienced several major bull markets, each reaching new all-time highs.

bitcoin_price_history.json
asset

Key Observations:

1. Early Phase 2014-2016: Bitcoin traded in a consolidation range between 178-975, establishing a foundation for future growth.

2. First Major Bull Run 2017: Bitcoin surged from under 1,000 to nearly 20,000, marking its first major parabolic move and mainstream recognition.

3. Bear Market Recovery 2018-2019: After the 2017 peak, Bitcoin declined to around 3,200 before beginning a gradual recovery.

4. Institutional Era 2020-2021: Driven by institutional adoption, stimulus measures, and growing mainstream acceptance, Bitcoin surpassed 60,000 for the first time.

5. New Heights 2024-2025: Bitcoin reached new all-time highs above 124,000, reflecting maturation of the cryptocurrency market.
